beats.direction: Use the recurring witness with an on-screen disclaimer: CITY CONTEXT / NOT DAY-SPECIFIC.
beats.voice: Shanghai compresses schedule, factory-city, social image, cloud runway, buyer order, product identity and distributed memory into synchronized platform time. This chapter follows staging: Atmosphere is engineered through temporary architecture, power, light, sound, seating, cueing, safety and teardown—then edited out of the effortless final image.
beats.onScreen: Then: Shanghai’s fashion geography includes converted textile infrastructure: the municipal record traces the International Fashion Center from a 1920s–30s mill to a renovated fashion complex.

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: Shanghai’s fashion geography includes converted textile infrastructure: the municipal record traces the International Fashion Center from a 1920s–30s mill to a renovated fashion complex. That earlier record fixes a point in time; it does not prove an inevitable progression toward the present.
beats.onScreen: Now: The municipal SS2026 notice describes Xintiandi’s main stages as modular structures with a dynamic visual system; this is an official programme claim, not an independent engineering audit.
beats.credit: Graphic © Rayven-Nikkita Collins; sources in claim ledger

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: The distinction is material. A polished interface can survive after its workers, contracts, specifications or permission trail disappear, leaving the audience with an outcome but not its operating history.
beats.onScreen: Next: Show-level contracts, permits, power, rigging, accessibility plans, suppliers and technical drawings remain unverified unless a venue, producer or authority releases them.
